profile.role_note: Works as either an on-field Basic Attack carry or an off-field Unison buffer.

pull_verdict.verdict: A strong pull if you own Hsin, or plan to get her. With Lily, the pair forms 3.8's top Unison team. Without Hsin, she is a harder sell. She becomes an on-field carry who wants Sanhua and a top healer beside her.
pull_verdict.verdict_label: Strong pull with Hsin, think twice without her

build.fast_path: Fast path: Unspoken Rue (or Emerald of Genesis / a Crit sword) + 5-piece Heart of Sworn Vigil in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Use a Crit DMG 4-cost, Electro DMG 3-costs, and ATK% 1-costs. Level her Forte Circuit first.

ranked_weapons.name: Unspoken Rue
ranked_weapons.note: 588 ATK, with a 24.3% Crit Rate substat. Gaining Unison grants her 30% Electro DMG Bonus. It also gives the whole team Binding Mind (+24% Electro DMG) for 30s. Spending under 100 Concerto Energy swaps Binding Mind for Yearning Mind (+40% Electro DMG for her alone, for 14s). Since Version 3.8, a full-Concerto Outro no longer triggers that swap. The team buff stays up, so Hsin keeps it through the whole rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: It has the same 588 ATK / 24.3% Crit Rate stats, and it boosts normal attack strings. The best alternative for long on-field windows.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: 24.3% Crit Rate and ATK boosts. Its Energy Regen also eases her Echo stat needs. Widely owned and dependable.

ranked_weapons.name: Unflickering Valor
ranked_weapons.note: 413 ATK and 77.04% Energy Regen, plus a +8% Crit Rate passive. Its Liberation triggers a Basic Attack DMG bonus. That feeds the same combo that builds her Delusion gauge.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss / Commando of Conviction
ranked_weapons.note: Free-to-play options. They buff Basic Attack DMG after a Resonance Skill cast, which matches her natural combat rhythm. Workable while you farm better pieces.

echo_sets.name: Heart of Sworn Vigil
echo_sets.note: 2-pc: +10% Electro DMG. 5-pc: +15% Crit Rate and +22.5% Electro DMG for 30s, when she inflicts Electro Flare, gains Unison, or triggers a Unison Response. She triggers these in both modes, so the set stays live in either playstyle. The agreed 3-costs are Formrender and Soulfrayer. The 1-costs are Kernel Puppet: Joy and Fog Lionarch: Body.

echo_sets.name: Flash of Electric Reflection
echo_sets.note: Only for running her purely as Hsin's buffer. Theorycrafters disagree on whether she applies Electro Flare reliably. Do not farm this first.

build.echo_set_note: Flower of Tinged Yearning (2pc +10% Healing Bonus) is Lily's Unison set. It is not a set for this build. Heart of Sworn Vigil, above, is the one to farm.

stat_priorities.note: Use Crit DMG if she runs her signature or another Crit sword — the weapon and her ascension bonuses supply plenty of Crit Rate. Use Crit Rate if her substats lack it.
Electro DMG Bonus on both. Every source agrees on this default.

substat_priority: Basic Attack DMG / ATK% (sources differ on order — both are close)
build.energy_regen_target: Enough for Liberation every Deep Mind cycle; comfort, not the main stat chase

teams.name: Premium: Hsin / Suoming / Lily (Unison quick-swap)

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The Electro hypercarry. Takes the field during the Unison window and spends it on her Resonance Skill burst, amplified by Suoming's buffs.

members.name: Suoming
members.note: The engine of the team. Builds her Delusion gauge in Deep Mind, fires her Liberation to gain Unison, then swaps out — handing Hsin Electro DMG and Resonance Skill DMG amplification while her Thunder Crest coordinated attacks keep striking.

members.name: Lily
members.note: The 3.8 upgrade. Her Outro hands the whole team 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s. Her healing covers the chip damage from the swap rotation. Her Unison ATK buff scales with how often the carries re-enter — and in this team, that is constantly.

teams.rotation: Lily opens with buffs and healing. Suoming enters through her Intro Skill. She builds Delusion and casts her Liberation for Unison. Swap to Hsin right away — her Outro and the free Intro fire without spending Concerto Energy. Play Hsin's window under the buffs. Then swap back when Hsin holds Unison, to trigger a Unison Response. Repeat.

teams.name: Alternative: Hsin / Suoming / Shorekeeper (Unison quick-swap)

members.name: Hsin
members.note: The Electro hypercarry. Takes the field during the Unison window and spends it on her Resonance Skill burst, amplified by Suoming's buffs.

members.name: Suoming
members.note: The engine of the team. Builds her Delusion gauge in Deep Mind, fires her Liberation to gain Unison, then swaps out — handing Hsin Electro DMG and Resonance Skill DMG amplification while her Thunder Crest coordinated attacks keep striking.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and hands out Crit buffs while barely needing field time, so she never breaks the Hsin-Suoming swap rhythm. (Suisui can sub in with healing plus Electro Flare support.)

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper opens with buffs and healing. Suoming enters through her Intro Skill. She builds Delusion and casts her Liberation for Unison. Swap to Hsin right away — her Outro and the free Intro fire without spending Concerto Energy. Play Hsin's window under the buffs. Then swap back when Hsin holds Unison, to trigger a Unison Response. Repeat.

teams.name: On-field carry: Suoming / Sanhua / Shorekeeper (no Hsin)

members.name: Suoming
members.note: The on-field carry. Spends Unison on Seal Master instead of handing it away — nearly all her damage in this window counts as Basic Attack DMG.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: The key partner. Her Outro Skill boosts Basic Attack DMG for the next character. That covers Suoming's enhanced Basic Attacks and Whirling Thunder. She is a cheap 4-star.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Keeps the team alive and boosts Suoming's Crit stats, making the long on-field window more forgiving to play.

teams.rotation: Sanhua opens and applies her Outro buff. Shorekeeper refreshes heals and buffs. Then Suoming takes the field for the long haul: Liberation into Rift Cleaver into Seal Master, then her enhanced attack string. Do not swap her out mid-window. All her damage is in the uninterrupted barrage.

teams.name: Budget: Suoming / Sanhua / Verina (F2P-friendly)

members.name: Suoming
members.note: Identical on-field Seal Master carry role — she is still the carry, spending Unison on her own Basic-Attack window.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Same Outro Basic Attack buff duty; free from the login event, so most accounts have her.

members.name: Verina
members.note: The standard-pool healer — pickable from the Beginner's Choice Convene — who heals and buffs team damage with short field time. Baizhi works as the fully free alternative.

teams.rotation: The same as the on-field team. Sanhua buffs. Verina heals and buffs. Suoming stays on-field through her window. You lose Shorekeeper's Crit buffs, so expect a lower ceiling. But the core loop stays intact, and it costs almost nothing beyond Suoming herself.

tier_badge.label: Top-tier
tier_badge.note: Community rankings (Nov 12, 2026) put her at T0 Hybrid in both Tower of Adversity and Whimpering Wastes. She is the on-field carry for Unison teams.

sequences.verdict: Launch-verified (checked Nov 13, 2026 against Game8 and wuthering.gg). S0 is a complete kit for both roles. S2 is the stop for Unison / Sub-DPS (Hsin) teams. S3 is the best general stopping point, and the Main DPS stop. S6 is the all-in ceiling.

pull_path.why: Full rotation at S0; S0 plus a good Crit sword is enough.
+40% Crit DMG and Outro Crit DMG for the incoming Resonator — the stopping point for Unison / Sub-DPS play.
A second Unison Boon source each rotation plus 30% Basic Attack DMG Amplification from Liberation — the Main DPS stop and the best stopping point for most players.
Unison Boon effect +50% (4-stack cap), Engraved Heart +50%, and +200% Crit DMG while Seal Master is active; lifts Hsin's buff too.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Get Unspoken Rue before dupes. Gurugamer's advice: stop at S0/S1 if you also want the weapon. S0 plus a Crit sword is enough.
